single_bridge.eligibility: strict integer V7 progress; endpoints, immutable arrays, ROM, collider, finite contact, analytic normal, root velocity and joint velocity all exact-PASS; the only exact failure is analytic tangential contact velocity

single_bridge.purpose: enter feasibility restoration without declaring a relaxed public PASS
single_bridge.persistence: solver-private memory for the current process only; no cache or candidate artifact

restoration_filter.funnel: over every active point, compute positive exact emitted analytic-tangent excess divided by 2000; compare (maximum excess ratio, sum excess ratio) lexicographically
restoration_filter.acceptance: retain strict nonzero integer V7 progress and every non-analytic exact constraint, then require a strict lexicographic funnel decrease
restoration_filter.fraction_selection: among eligible strictly decreasing fractions minimize (new funnel maximum, new funnel sum, negative V7 distance-improvement basis points, frozen fraction ordinal)
restoration_filter.reanchor: after every accepted intermediate, quantize q, canonicalize quaternion, apply continuous-V9 yaw lift, and rederive v/a/effectors/colliders before the next linearization
restoration_filter.failure: if no fraction is exact-PASS or filter-acceptable, terminate STOP_AND_RESEARCH; do not tune, restart, reuse the unaccepted float state or relax a limit
